newsitem.title: USA: Elkem restarts US ferro-silicon furnace.
newsitem.headline: Elkem restarts US ferro-silicon furnace.

text.p: Elkem Metals Co, the North American division of Norway's Elkem, said it was restarting a ferro-silicon furnace in Alloy, W.Va., in December.
Elkem said the move was due to reduced hydroelectric power generation in Norway and planned major maintenance in mid-1997 at its Chicoutimi ferro-silicon plant in Quebec.
Elkem will restart Alloy's No 9, 20 megawatt furnace which produces standard grade 75 percent ferro-silicon for the North American steel and foundry industry.

Elkem said last month that a shortfall in its captive hydro power production in Norway, due to exceptionally light rainfall last winter and low reservoir levels, added 80 million crowns to the group's expenses for the first nine months of 1996.
